fields.text: Synthetic data pack: every value is a hand-made model setting or test data, not real city data
Synthetic city K51
Synthetic city: devices are cheap and human services are expensive; housing, food, jobs, courses and treatment are the same as in M52
Synthetic city M52
Synthetic city: human services are cheap and devices are expensive; everything else is the same as in K51

The new flow lets you browse the occupation catalog by group or search it and pick one directly (see input_catalog; no text needed). Describing your work in words is kept only for compatibility: the system offers a few readable candidates (name and duties) from the aliases of a controlled vocabulary, and you confirm one. Classification codes stay internal; you never need to enter one. When nothing matches, the system says why and never turns you into a “generic office worker”
Material life

What you actually get from consumption: the condition of your home, whether food is fresh and to your taste, whether phone, internet and household supplies are convenient, whether daily chores are easy, and clothing and personal care (split into four items inside)

Reference situation: from a one-bedroom far away, eating mostly rice, flour and canned food and doing all the laundry and cleaning yourself, to three fresh-ingredient meals a day and about 18 fewer hours of housework a month (one step of improvement in this version's synthetic model)
Housing condition, food, daily support and convenience, and personal consumption and enjoyment are all scored on actual life; other material needs such as storage are not in this version
Safety
Public safety conditions in the city
Reference situation: a synthetic safety index rising from 4 to 8 (0–10, comparable only among this set of synthetic cities)
This version has only the city's background conditions; clones cannot improve it by spending or acting
Opportunity
The career and growth conditions the city offers, plus new abilities you actually learn in your life
Reference situation: finishing a 12-month qualification course within a year, or the city's opportunity conditions rising from a synthetic index of 4 to 8
City background + the learning you actually take part in; certificates themselves, job changes and pay rises earn nothing extra
Leisure
The city's basic leisure conditions, plus exercise, shows and other activities you actually take part in
Reference situation: from no activities at all each month to going to the gym 8 times a month
Only activities that actually happen count; matching specific hobbies to geography is not in this version
Environment
Background conditions of air, climate and the urban environment
Reference situation: a synthetic environment index rising from 4 to 8 (0–10, comparable only among this set of synthetic cities)
This version has only the city's background conditions; clones cannot improve it by acting
Ease of commuting
How the round-trip time between home and work and the number of days you actually go to work affect your life
Reference situation: with 20 days on site a month, the daily round trip shrinking from 70 to 30 minutes
Scored on the round-trip minutes from the home you actually live in and the days you actually go to work; non-work trips are not detailed in this version
Housing condition
The condition of the home you actually live in: whether there is enough space, and how good it is among homes of its kind

Only the home itself counts; rent, commuting and the area's safety and environment are not in this item (safety and environment are counted separately by the area you live in); the old “living space (floor area only)” meant something different, so old confirmations need a new review
Food
Whether the complete food plan you actually eat (cooking at home or eating out) is fresh and matches the taste you confirmed

Only fresh meals and the cuisines you confirmed are evaluated; having enough to eat is a basic guarantee and earns nothing extra; price, restaurant tier and how often you eat out do not mean better; preparation time counts in the time budget
Daily support and convenience
Whether phone and internet service and household supplies are easy to get, and whether daily chores are easy.

Chores count by how many hours you actually do less yourself (devices and human services are two ways to get there and are not scored separately); phone, home internet and household supplies count by the months actually bought, and buying two of the same item counts no more; it is relative importance, not a budget or an order to buy; it covers phone service and household supplies beyond the old “daily convenience”, so old confirmations need a new review
Personal consumption and enjoyment
Beyond other living costs, the satisfaction of personal consumption such as clothing and personal care.

Evaluated by the standard personal consumption basket (clothing, shoes and accessories, personal care) you actually get each month, not by how much you spend; the same basket costing more does not change this item, only buying less lowers it; it is an explainable model abstraction and does not measure a real person's happiness; massages and home comfort goods are no longer counted separately; the meaning differs from the old version, so old confirmations need a new review
Manual entries are parsed as exact decimals with at most 2 decimal places (the step is not a measurement precision); fractions in lowest terms are also accepted (for example 50/3)
A whole number after reducing (30) or numerator/denominator (50/3); calculations and comparisons use it, display rounds to 1 decimal place, and displayed values never feed back into calculations
The six areas must add up to exactly 100; no values are pre-filled, no personality presets are offered, and other items are never reduced proportionally
An equal split is generated only when the user chooses “split equally” (50/3 for each of the six areas, 25 for each material item), so items listed first get no extra points
An explicit 0 is a provided value; “not answered”, “explicitly no strong view” and “not sure yet” are never turned into 0 or an equal share automatically
When material life is positive, the four material items must also add up to exactly 100; when material life is explicitly 0, the breakdown does not apply and no four answers are invented
Since material life went from three items to four and the meaning of food widened, old confirmations cannot be carried over by adding a 0 or redistributing points: please review and confirm again
Rate each item separately from 0 to 100: the slider moves 1 point at a time, and you can also type up to two decimals; the ratings need not add up to 100

Once every item that needs an answer is rated and the total is above 0, E3 turns ratings into weights as “100 × this item's rating ÷ the sum of all ratings” (exact fractions, no extra factors); scaling all ratings by the same factor leaves the weights unchanged

Not answered is not 0; “no strong view” and “not sure yet” keep their own state and are not turned into numbers; if every rating is 0 you cannot confirm, and the system does not split the weight evenly for you
“Equal weight” means you actively set every item to 50 points (each of the six dimensions gets 50/3, each of the four material items gets 25)

When material life gets 0 points, the four material items do not apply: the points you already gave stay in the draft but are not used this time; they come back as they were when material life is above 0 again
Assume your basic living needs are covered, and judge whether each choice below describes you. There are no right answers.
One arrangement earns a little more money, but also makes it more likely that you get sick and need a few days of rest. I am willing to choose it.
To be ready for possible health costs, I am willing to postpone a purchase I want but do not urgently need, and set some money aside first.
When information about a health risk is still unclear, I am willing to give up a small immediate gain and decide once things are clear.
Describes me
This statement describes the user
Does not describe me
This statement does not describe the user
No clear tendency
The user has no clear tendency on this question
Not sure yet
The user is not sure yet: there is no explicit instruction for this item
An unanswered question is stored as “not answered”, separately from “not sure yet”; both mean there is no explicit instruction for that item, and no middle value is filled in
No total health score is calculated, and no disease probability, pain weight, treatment effect, willingness to pay or refusal of treatment is inferred
Health answers take none of the six areas' 100 points and are not a seventh scoring weight; they only inform the clones' planning and do not change illness rules, γ, H, accounts or satisfaction
The questions are provisional wording, not tested in cognitive interviews or validated as a scale
Round trip between home and the employment center no longer than (minutes)
minutes
E1 hard requirement: in the housing category, the longest round-trip minutes in the commute execution record ≤ the given minutes (checked every month; months without days on site count as 0)
The round-trip minutes from the home actually lived in are checked every month: met, not met and cannot be determined are reported separately; this does not enter the score and does not block plans

The text is recorded; this version has no way to check or block in-home services, so clones may choose them: even if you confirm this as non-negotiable, it can only be kept as written
Accounting practice qualification (synthetic)
Asked only when your chosen occupation or a job in a candidate city requires it; never granted automatically from a job title

Liquid funds you can actually spend, entered in 2024 US dollars at local price levels; the same basis as the catalogue, so the conversion is the identity, with no inflation or exchange-rate conversion

Amounts are accepted in only two forms: an ungrouped non-negative decimal (for example 3000.50), or thousands grouped strictly in threes (for example 3,000.50); the decimal point must be “.”, with at most two decimal places. Forms such as “3000,50”, “3,,000” or “1,23.45” are rejected; the system does not guess what you meant
This is a simplified scenario of moving to a candidate city and starting over: it starts in year 1, healthy, with no belongings, no courses in progress and no savings goal
Real old furniture, medical history and ongoing courses are not included yet; this is an assumption of the simulation, not a judgement about your real situation
The same you has the same age, cash, abilities and base time and energy in every city and every clone; specific jobs in a city are matched against the local catalogue
Fixed remote income, shared household assets, multi-person households, buying a home and loans
Comparisons across countries and wealth conversion across currencies
Scoring of brands, cuisines, preparation, tier, service quality and home-visit concerns (the text is only recorded)
Pausing monthly services that need none of your time during illness to save money
Interview-style input (only the interfaces for sources and evidence references are kept)
Cities, quotes, wages, taxes, illness and treatment are all synthetic settings; the results do not rank real cities and are not real-world recommendations
The offline planner is a controllable mock and does not represent a real large language model's ability or understanding of preferences
The questionnaire wording and reference improvement ranges are provisional drafts, not tested in cognitive interviews or validated as a scale

离线规划器是可控的 mock，不代表真实大语言模型的能力或偏好理解
问卷文案与参考改善范围是暂定稿，没有做认知访谈与量表验证

material_leaves.definition: 实际住的那一处房子本身的条件：空间够不够用、同类房子里条件好不好
material_leaves.label: 居住条件
material_leaves.note: 只看房子本身；房租、通勤、地区的安全与环境不在这一项（安全、环境按住处所在片区另算）；旧版的“居住空间（只看面积）”含义不同，旧的确认要重新审阅

material_leaves.definition: 实际吃的完整食品方案（自己做、外食都可以）新鲜不新鲜、合不合你确认的口味
material_leaves.label: 饮食生活
material_leaves.note: 只评价新鲜餐与你确认的菜系；吃饱是基本保障，不另加分；价格、餐馆档次与外食次数不等于更好；准备时间算在时间账里

material_leaves.definition: 通信联网、家用日耗品是否方便获得，以及日常杂务是否省心。
material_leaves.label: 日常支持与便利
material_leaves.note: 杂务看本人实际少做了多少小时（设备与人工服务是两种实现方式，不分别打分）；通信、居家联网与家用日耗品看实际买到的月份，同一项买两份不多算；它是相对重要程度，不是预算或必须购买的指令；含义比旧版“日常生活便利”多了通信与日耗品，旧的确认要重新审阅

material_leaves.definition: 在其他生活开支之外，获得衣着、个人护理等个人消费的满足。
material_leaves.label: 个人消费与享受
material_leaves.note: 按每月实际获得的标准个人消费篮子（衣着、鞋履与配饰、个人护理）评价，不按花了多少钱；同样的篮子涨价不改变这一项，买得少才会少；是可解释的模型抽象，没有测量真实人的幸福感；不再单独计算按摩或居家舒适用品；含义与旧版不同，旧的确认要重新审阅

data_pack.note: 合成资料包：全部数值是手工合成的模型设定或测试资料，不是真实城市资料

money_bases.note: 按 2024 年美元、当地价格水平填写的可动用流动资金；与目录同一口径，换算是恒等，不做通胀或汇率换算

source.money_input_rule_zh: 金额只接受两种写法：不分组的非负十进制（例如 3000.50），或严格每三位一组的千分位（例如 3,000.50）；小数点只能用“.”，最多两位小数。“3000,50”“3,,000”“1,23.45”这类写法会被拒绝，系统不猜你的意思

occupation.note: 新流程从职业目录按分类浏览或搜索后直接选（见 input_catalog，不需要写文字）。文字描述只为兼容保留：系统按受控词表的别名给出少量可读候选（名称与职责），由你确认。分类代码只在内部保留，不需要、也不会请你填写；匹配不到时说明原因，不自动改成“普通白领”

points.canonical_form: 约分后的整数（30）或 分子/分母（50/3）；计算与比较都用它，显示四舍五入到 1 位小数，显示值不回流计算
points.manual_entry: 手工输入按精确十进制解析，最多 2 位小数（步长不是测量精度）；也接受规范分数写法（例如 50/3）

rules: 每一项单独打 0–100 分：滑条一次 1 分，也可以输入最多两位小数；不必凑满 100
全部要回答的项都打了分、合计大于 0 之后，E3 按“100 × 这一项的评分 ÷ 全部评分之和”换成权重（精确分数，不加任何系数）；评分同比例放大或缩小，权重不变
未答不是 0；“无所谓”“暂不确定”保留原状态，不换成数值；全部是 0 时不能确认，系统也不会自动平均分配
“同等重视”是你主动把每一项都设为 50 分（六维各得 50/3、物质四项各得 25）
物质生活打 0 分时物质四项不适用：已经打的分留在草稿里，不参与这一次的换算；物质重新大于 0 时照原样恢复
六维合计必须精确等于 100；不预填数值、不提供人格套餐，不自动按比例扣减其他项
只有用户主动选择“平均分配”才生成均分（六维每项 50/3、物质每项 25），不让排在前面的项目多拿分
明确 0 是已提供的数值；“未答”“明确无所谓”“暂不确定”都不会被自动换成 0 或均分
物质父项为正时，物质四项也必须精确合计 100；物质父项明确为 0 时细分不适用，不伪造四个回答
物质从三项改成四项、饮食的含义扩大之后，旧的确认不能补 0 或重新分配点数沿用：请重新审阅并确认

start_scenario: 这是一次搬到候选城市重新开始的简化情景：从第 1 年、健康、没有已有物品、没有在学课程、没有资金目标开始
现实中的旧家具、病史与在学课程暂未纳入；这是模拟的假设，不是对你现实情况的判断
同一个你在各城市、各个分身里的年龄、现金、能力与基础时间精力都相同；城市里的具体岗位按当地目录匹配
unsupported: 固定远程收入、家庭共同资产、多人家庭、买房与贷款
跨国比较与跨币种的财富换算
品牌、菜系、制作方式、档次、服务质量与上门顾虑的评分（只记录原文）
生病时暂停零参与时间的按月服务来省钱
访谈式输入（只保留来源与证据引用接口）
